trap-superlative.evidence: 'admits a **tighter** symbolic refinement'; 'This refinement tightens the CODATA residual from $+1677.5$ ppm to $+305.7$ ppm'; 'The **minimal** even-power resummation that **matches the linear bridge at the perturbative level** is the cosine'; 'The classical cosine is more accurate by $\approx 7$ ppm'.
trap-superlative.notes: FOUR FINDINGS; the arithmetic is right and the STRUCTURE is not. (a) THE RESULT IS CONVENTION-C-ONLY. This block sets $z = 1/(\sqrt q + 1/\sqrt q) = \sqrt q/(q+1) = 0.49932$, which is the trace convention the 2026-08-15 owner ruling EXCISED; canonical convention D is $z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.61269$. Recomputing the block's own construction under D: alpha = -0.0404858, cos = 0.99918056, Q^{A,cos} = 0.7830037, residual 856.7 ppm -- so the headline '5.49x tighter' becomes 1.96x and the 306 ppm becomes 857 ppm. The result does not survive the canonical convention. (b) CONSTRAINT (1) ALSO FAILS UNDER D. The block's bar-involution argument needs z invariant under q -> 1/q. VERIFIED: z_C(1/q) = z_C(q) = 0.499320334034 exactly, but z_D(1/q) = 0.403628 against z_D(q) = 0.612688. The evenness-in-alpha argument is a property of convention C, not of the Markov trace. (c) 'MATCHES THE LINEAR BRIDGE AT THE PERTURBATIVE LEVEL' IS FALSE. cos(alpha) = 1 - alpha^2/2 + O(alpha^4) has NO linear term, while the bridge factor is 1 + alpha. Numerically 1 + alpha = 0.9476639 against cos alpha = 0.9986308 -- 5.4% apart, not a perturbative match. Replacing one by the other is a different correction at a different order, not a resummation of the same series. (d) The 7 ppm classical-vs-q-deformed margin is used to select between variants inside a 306 ppm residual, i.e. 44x below the block's own error bar; the data cannot distinguish them. VERIFIED SOUND: every printed number reproduces -- alpha = -0.052336, cos = 0.9986308, 1677.5 ppm and 305.7 ppm (I get 1677.54 and 306.02) and 5.49x.
